```
['test the TsFeatures transform method to extract statistical and seasonal features from a univariate time series', 'test the TsFeatures transform method on multivariate time series data and verify per-column feature extraction', 'test the TsFeatures class with selected_features to compute only a subset of features like var and linearity', 'test the TsFeatures class with extension features like cusum_detector, bocp_detector, and nowcasting features', 'test the TsFourierFeatures class to compute Fourier sine and cosine features from time series timestamps']
```
